description: Provider-free live package skeleton for generic AI record/replay fixtures, strict ordered matching, mismatch findings, and deterministic replay summaries.

credentials.policy: No credentials are declared by this skeleton; provider SDKs, model credentials, and network clients belong only to future provider-specific packages behind explicit capability gates.

test_gates: manifest and referenced JSON files decode without external dependencies
provider_free is true, domain_specific is false, and live_network_default is false
record schema requires record_id, sequence, replay_key, operation, capability, request_hash, response_hash, request, response, provider_free, and recorded_at
record schema forbids provider SDK, credential, and network client fields
fixture index declares strict_ordered matching and deterministic summary field order
strict ordered replay compares only the next unconsumed record and never scans ahead
mismatch findings include expected and actual request hashes plus the replay cursor
unconsumed record handling emits deterministic finding records after request replay ends
matching summary is stable for equivalent fixture inputs

no_built_in_guarantee.statement: Leia core does not provide provider-backed record/replay storage, model clients, or network capture as built-ins; future external packages must satisfy these provider-free contracts first.
